# The Capacity Playbook and Carrier Confidence


-


10/20/26


As competition intensifies across the program market, Patrick Charles, Global Head of P&C Programs at SiriusPoint, discusses what distinguishes successful program administrators and how they can build lasting confidence among carriers, reinsurers and investors.


Writing for The Insurer, as part of this year’s Target Markets Program Administrators Association 26th Annual Summit, Patrick covers operational excellence, data and portfolio visibility, and alignment which he believes is key to the long-term success of a program partnership.


[Click here](https://www.theinsurer.com/program-manager/viewpoint/siriuspoints-charles-the-capacity-playbook-and-carrier-confidence-2026-10-19/?utm_source=Sailthru&utm_medium=Newsletter&utm_campaign=Reinsurance-Month-TMPAA-Daily&utm_term=101926&lctg=672aa5f67e891c1ce26c75ed) to read the article in full in Program Manager.
